description: Standalone consent-aware runtime for crossing, clean return, durable lamination, deliberate human review, and explicit accepted-continuity export.
standaloneHealthCheck: node cli.mjs health && node lamination-cli.mjs health && node review-room-server.mjs health && node continuity-cli.mjs health
consentRequirements: Packets cross only while consent_state is open
Feather or Icarus pauses the bridge
Lamination occurs only after CLOSED with an explicit clean-return receipt
Original lamination receipts remain immutable during review
New Review Room items cannot originate external-observation claims
Continuity export requires an explicit user action after review
Only accepted review items enter a continuity packet
Continuity export does not commit canon automatically
deviceRequirements: modern browser for the Review Room interface
importProcedure: Place valid bridge and lamination ledgers in ./data before launch. Review requires bridge-lamination.latest.json; continuity export requires bridge-lamination.reviewed.latest.json.
exportProcedure: Copy all bridge-session, lamination, review, and continuity JSONL and latest JSON files from ./data.
healthChecks: Bridge process starts without Hearthfire, Hearthgate, STARWELL, Notion, Supabase, or DEEP
Lamination process starts without Hearthfire, Hearthgate, STARWELL, Notion, Supabase, or DEEP
Review Room starts without Hearthfire, Hearthgate, STARWELL, Notion, Supabase, or DEEP
Continuity exporter starts without Hearthfire, Hearthgate, STARWELL, Notion, Supabase, or DEEP
Lamination receipt count and paths are visible
Review Room reports whether a laminate is available and how many reviews exist
Continuity health reports reviewed-source availability and packet count
acceptanceTests: One full OPEN to CLOSED vertical slice
Pause blocks packets
Plain pass preserves controls
Targetside external-evidence claims are rejected
Notch returns cleanly
Ledger replay preserves packet order
A clean return produces one four-layer lamination receipt
A non-closed bridge cannot be laminated
A missing clean-return receipt blocks lamination
Targetside narrative cannot be laminated as external observation
Sourced Hearthside external observations preserve provenance
A review includes one decision for every original laminate item
A review leaves the original laminate unchanged
A review writes an append-only review receipt and reviewed-latest derivative
Stale lamination reviews are rejected
New Review Room items cannot invent external observations
Only accepted items appear in continuity packets
Held, rejected, and candidate items remain excluded but counted
Continuity packets preserve source item, packet, review, session, world, and anchor provenance
Repeated export of the same reviewed layer is idempotent
A stale review id blocks continuity export
A continuity packet explicitly records canon_commit false
The browser room and all review and continuity routes open over loopback HTTP
knownLimitations: v0.4 uses a manual world/canon resolver
The Review Room is standalone and not yet mounted behind a Hearthgate door
Continuity packets are portable local records and are not yet ingested by Arcsweep, the Knowledge Graph, Notion, or Supabase
Continuity export deliberately does not commit canon automatically
Host adapters remain optional and reversible
